title: 总结与结论

sentenceFrames.pattern: ：At the end of the day, [core message / bottom line].
sentenceFrames.usage: 抛开所有细节，说出最核心的那句话。非常有说服力。
sentenceFrames.example: At the end of the day, it doesn't matter which method you use — what matters is that you show up every day.
substitutions: 关于学英语：At the end of the day, _____.
关于职业选择：At the end of the day, _____.
关于人际关系：At the end of the day, _____.
你最近在思考的事：At the end of the day, _____.

sentenceFrames.pattern: ：So what I'm trying to say is [distilled point].
sentenceFrames.usage: 感觉自己说了很多，用这句话把最核心的意思提炼出来。
sentenceFrames.example: So what I'm trying to say is, we need to stop treating speaking as a test and start treating it as a skill.
substitutions: 关于为什么 CET-6 的人说不出英语 → So what I'm trying to say is, _____.
关于社交媒体的影响 → So what I'm trying to say is, _____.
关于你的人生哲学 → So what I'm trying to say is, _____.

sentenceFrames.pattern: ：The bottom line is [most important point]. Everything else is secondary.
sentenceFrames.usage: 最强力的总结，用于定调。"其他的都不重要，这才是最关键的。"
sentenceFrames.example: The bottom line is you have to speak to get better at speaking. Everything else — textbooks, apps, grammar exercises — is secondary.
substitutions: The bottom line is **practice beats theory every time.** Everything else is secondary.
关于健康：The bottom line is _____. Everything else is secondary.
关于幸福：The bottom line is _____. Everything else is secondary.
关于你坚信的一件事：The bottom line is _____. Everything else is secondary.
